profile.name: SocketCAN 多速率周期发送任务
profile.description: 这是一个基于 SocketCAN 的 CAN 总线周期发送任务，用于按固定周期或多速率方式重复发送 CAN 报文。它支持设置发送持续时间、在任务运行中修改报文数据，以及停止后再次启动，常用于实验设备之间的 CAN 通信测试、自动控制和报文注入。
profile.description_en: This is a SocketCAN-based CAN bus cyclic transmission task used to repeatedly send CAN messages at a fixed cycle or multiple rates. It supports setting a transmission duration, modifying message data while configured, and stopping then restarting the task. It is commonly used for CAN communication testing, automated control, and message injection between laboratory devices.
